title: Metabotropic Glutamate Receptor 5 (mGluR5)
mechanism: Negative allosteric modulation (NAM) in the mGluR5 TMD dampens excessive cortico-striatal glutamatergic drive onto D1-MSNs (Vina −9.63, MPO 5.85).
clinical_precedent: Dipraglurant & Mavoglurant (lead beats Dipraglurant in Vina)
